answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 145761 Country: INDIA Title: Whether I can sell a property on installments at a higher price if the payment is to made at a later date? Question: Whether I can sell a property on installments at a higher price if the payment is to made at a later date? Answer ID: 145761 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 162/153/M=2/1438) It is lawful to sell goods or property on installments for higher price provided the dealing is finalized already. In case the payment is not made on the deadline, it will not be lawful to increase the amount. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
